description: Proposed Single Storey Rear,Two Storey Side Extensions, Widening of existing drive, External Insulation and Render finish to all existing external walls with Associated Internal / External works.
decision_conditions:
Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

<p>Flood Risk –</p><p>The flood mitigation measures shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved in accordance with submitted approved plans and householder flood risk form, and shall be retained thereafter for the provision of flood proofing measures and surface water drainage.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To ensure satisfactory means of surface water drainage, to reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021, policy CS16 of Merton's Core Planning Strategy 2011 and policy DM F2 of Merton's Sites and Policies Plan 2014.</p><div><br></div>

No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.

﻿Hardstanding (Flooding) - The hardstanding hereby permitted shall be made of porous materials, or provision made to direct surface water run-off to a permeable or porous area or surface within the application site before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use.

Reason:  To reduce surface water run-off and to reduce pressure on the surrounding drainage system in accordance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI12 of the London Plan 2021 and policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local Plan 2024.
